env-params.name: AI_PROVIDER
env-params.description: AI provider name, e.g. 'openai', 'google', 'anthropic'

env-params.name: AI_MODEL
env-params.description: AI model name

env-params.name: AI_BASE_URL
env-params.description: Base URL for the Ollama server (required for AI_PROVIDER=gemma, e.g. http://localhost:11434)

env-params.name: AI_API_KEY
env-params.description: AI API key

env-params.name: AI_MAX_TOKENS
env-params.description: Max tokens for a single response

env-params.name: AI_TEMPERATURE
env-params.description: Temperature (0.0 for strict QA/Logic, 0.7 for creative)

env-params.name: GLOBAL_CONTEXT
env-params.description: Path to a JSON file of global variables/URLs injected into the system prompt

env-params.name: EXTRA_INSTRUCTION
env-params.description: Path to a Markdown file whose content is appended to the system prompt; ignored if the file does not exist

env-params.name: PRESET_CONTEXT
env-params.description: Path to a JSON file of preset user context values seeded into ContextManager before any task runs; ignored if the file does not exist

env-params.name: TEST_RUN_TIMEOUT
env-params.description: Maximum total duration (in seconds) for the entire test run before it is stopped with status 'timeout'

env-params.name: STEP_TIMEOUT_SEC
env-params.description: Maximum duration (in seconds) the agent may idle without receiving an LLM response per step before the task is marked failed

env-params.name: TOOL_CALL_TIMEOUT_SEC
env-params.description: Maximum duration (in seconds) a single MCP tool call may run before it is aborted and reported as a tool error

env-params.name: MAX_SNAPSHOTS_HISTORY
env-params.description: Maximum number of recent browser_snapshot tool results to keep in LLM message history; non-positive values are treated as 1

env-params.name: CONTEXT_COMPRESSION
env-params.description: Enable message compression (planning + history compaction after complete_verification); true only when value is 'true' (case-insensitive)

env-params.name: COMPRESSION_DEBUG
env-params.description: Enable one compression debug log per compression right before the next LLM call; true only when value is 'true' (case-insensitive)

env-params.name: COMPRESSION_DEBUG_INCLUDE_REQUEST
env-params.description: When COMPRESSION_DEBUG is enabled, include compressed summary and safe recent tail in the debug payload; true only when value is 'true' (case-insensitive)

env-params.name: COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD_MIN
env-params.description: Initial input token threshold for compression eligibility; compression is not triggered until a request input token count reaches this value; non-positive values fall back to 12500

env-params.name: COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD_LEAP
env-params.description: Step size for advancing the compression threshold after each compression; non-positive values fall back to 5000

env-params.name: LARGE_CONTENT_THRESHOLD
env-params.description: UTF-8 byte threshold for large content guards in API logging and snapshot retention; non-positive values fall back to 10000

env-params.name: RATE_LIMIT_RETRY
env-params.description: Maximum number of allowed rate-limit retries per task; negative values allow unlimited retries

env-params.name: MAX_ITERATIONS
env-params.description: Maximum number of LLM call iterations per task before the loop is forcibly stopped

env-params.name: ENABLE_API_LOGGING
env-params.description: Enable request/response API content logging for LLM provider calls; true only when value is 'true' (case-insensitive)

env-params.name: MAXIMUM_RESTRICTED_TOOL_USAGE
env-params.description: Maximum number of restricted tool calls allowed without a successful verification or context update before the task is failed; 0 or negative values disable the guard

env-params.name: SKILLS_DIR
env-params.description: Directory of user <skill-name>/SKILL.md skill folders; ignored if it does not exist. Built-in skills live in ./builtin-skills and are not configurable.
